title: Solr: jackson-databind validates the outer class of a class-name type ID but accepts… (CVE-2026-110879)
description: CVE-2026-110879 affects multiple packages. jackson-databind validates the outer class of a class-name type ID but accepts attacker-selected classes inside its generic arguments, even when those classes violate the declared type or would be rejected as direct type IDs. See references for individual vulnerability details.
